subject: I coudn't agree more.
author: Linkster
body:
With the paltry number of achievements on all the DLC it seems to me like CG are dissing the 360 a little.  Under the new DLC rules they could have easily added 10 new achievements with 25GS each.  As they are I reckon all the new ones can be gotten in under 3 hours.

 

Don't get me wrong I'm not a GS whore and the DLC is more about having fun but it would have been nice to show us X360 owners a little more love.

subject: "cool, thanks for letting us
author: gravy666
body:
"cool, thanks for letting us know, I have added the list to our front page story. It is very frustrating that CG do not do the same achievements as they do PS3 trophies, and there excuse about limits are pretty lame. Especially as the rules have changed and DLC is now allowed 250gs extra per premium DLC, so why only add 110 GS with the Island?? and why only spread that 110 over only 5 achievements??

I just don't get it!"

I'm not so sure about why there's only an extra 110 Achievement points, but otherwise Criterion need to make the Achievements worthwhile.  Having an actually number of points, it needs to satisfy everyone, including the Achievement... Hounds, to put it nicely.
